issues.description: The problem statement (UML) and instructions require the Lecture constructor to initialize attributes in the order: lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors. The solution's Lecture constructor uses a different parameter order (lectureName, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents). This mismatch is structural and will confuse students about the expected constructor signature and parameter ordering (and may cause tests that check the constructor signature/order to fail).
issues.suggestedFix: Align the constructor parameter order with the UML/specification. Change the constructor signature to: Lecture(String lectureName, int numberOfInscribedStudents, int numberOfGuestStudents, int numberOfLecturers, int numberOfTutors) and assign fields accordingly. Alternatively, if the other order was intended, update the problem statement and template to document and expect that constructor order so students and tests are consistent.
